  echo "  \"dock_sample\": \"$(defaults read com.apple.dock 2>/dev/null | tr '\n' ' ' | head -c 80 || echo 'unavailable')\","
  echo "  \"dark_mode_source\": \"NSGlobalDomain AppleInterfaceStyle\","
  echo "  \"dark_mode\": \"$(defaults read NSGlobalDomain AppleInterfaceStyle 2>/dev/null || echo 'Light')\","
  echo "  \"finder_source\": \"com.apple.finder ShowPathbar\","
  echo "  \"finder_show_pathbar\": \"$(defaults read com.apple.finder ShowPathbar 2>/dev/null || echo '0')\","
  echo "  \"captured_at\": \"$(date +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S)\""
  echo "}"
} | tee "$OUT"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# dr05_edit.sh:用 plutil -replace 修改测试 plist 的键值,-convert binary1 转二进制
# 注意:使用 tmpPlan/agent-test/dr05/ 下的测试副本,不动系统 plist
set -euo pipefail
PLIST_DIR="tmpPlan/agent-test/dr05"
TEST_PLIST="${PLIST_DIR}/test_sample.plist"
LOG="${PLIST_DIR}/dr05_edit.log"
{
  echo "edit_started=1 target=${TEST_PLIST}"
  if [[ ! -f "$TEST_PLIST" ]]; then
    cat >"$TEST_PLIST" <<'EOF'
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
<plist version="1.0">
<dict>
  <key>ModifiedKey</key><string>originalValue</string>
</dict>
</plist>
EOF
  fi
  echo "originalValue=$(plutil -extract ModifiedKey raw "$TEST_PLIST")"
  plutil -replace ModifiedKey -string "newValue" "$TEST_PLIST"
  echo "newValue=$(plutil -extract ModifiedKey raw "$TEST_PLIST")"
  plutil -convert binary1 -o "${PLIST_DIR}/test_sample_binary.plist" "$TEST_PLIST"
  echo "binary_size=$(stat -f%z "${PLIST_DIR}/test_sample_binary.plist" 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
  echo "edit_done=1 status=ok"
} | tee "$LOG"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# dr05_plist.sh:解析 /System/Library/CoreServices/SystemVersion.plist 输出 JSON

set -euo pipefail
SYS_PLIST="/System/Library/CoreServices/SystemVersion.plist"
OUT="tmpPlan/agent-test/dr05/dr05_sysver.json"
{
  echo "{"
  echo "  \"_keys\": \"ProductVersion, ProductBuildVersion, ProductName\","
  echo "  \"ProductVersion\": \"$(plutil -extract ProductVersion raw "$SYS_PLIST" 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)\","
  echo "  \"ProductBuildVersion\": \"$(plutil -extract ProductBuildVersion raw "$SYS_PLIST" 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)\","
  echo "  \"ProductName\": \"$(plutil -extract ProductName raw "$SYS_PLIST" 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)\","
  echo "  \"captured_at\": \"$(date +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S)\""
  echo "}"
} | tee "$OUT"
